<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/campaign"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Saves a campaign in the caller's organization: an agent and a spec of the attacks to run against it. The target comes from the agent and the execution settings from the server, so the spec has no `target` or `execution`. The spec is validated as the SDK would (techniques, their parameters and roles, judges, dataset), and credentials must be `${VARIABLE}` references to organization secrets. Nothing runs until the campaign is launched (`POST /campaign/{id}/launch`). 403 when the caller has no organization.
